newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lion appoints MD for Australian unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lion appoints MD for Australian unit.

text.p: New Zealand brewer Lion Nathan Ltd said on Wednesday it had appointed Gordon Cairns to the position of managing director of the company's Australian brewing operations.

The recently-announced move by Tony van Kralingen from South Africa to take up this position was unable to be completed, Kevin Roberts, chief operating officer for Lion Nathan, said in a statement. Cairns is currently managing director of Pepsi Cola Bottlers Australia, a unit of Lion Nathan.
Van Kralingen said unforeseen family reasons had emerged which prevented him leaving South Africa to settle in Australia.
Cairns' role at Pepsi will be taken by John Crawford, currently the managing director of Pepsi Cola Bottlers New Zealand, Roberts said.
"While we are disappointed that Tony was not able to stay with us, I am pleased that we have been able to appoint proven executives from within Lion Nathan," Roberts said.
